name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct as EXCAVA’s primary inference engine. Its MoE design delivers higher throughput than dense models at lower cost, directly raising EXCAVA’s capability per dollar spent. The trade-off is accepting slightly lower single-request latency for sustained multi-request performance, which matters more for EXCAVA’s workload. DeepSeek-V3-671B-Instruct remains a fallback for tasks where its larger context window outweighs Qwen3’s speed.

name: Torque
text: Qwen3-235B’s 128K context window cuts EXCAVA’s long-document performance by ~20%—that’s the real risk, not latency. A better alternative is testing Llama-4-Maverick-12B-Instruct; it’s newer, denser, and likely handles long docs better for a 0.5% gain. Settle it by running a blind benchmark on 100 long documents—winner gets the switch.
